verdict.rationale: Deepgram Voice Agent's core function is natural, spoken-language interaction: callers 'speak naturally, and hold a conversation with an AI that can be interrupted mid-sentence, the way people talk to each other,' with barge-in support and prompt-driven behavior shaping live-call responses. This is well documented across multiple first-party docs describing the conversational, natural-language operating model. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and clearer treatment of natural-language 'command' style operation (vs. free conversation) for task execution.
